name: logo-origami
blurb: Logos flip on center axis, cycling through items on a timer.
description: Cycles through child content on a timer, with upper and lower halves rotating away and in on a 3D X-axis to reveal the next item.
use_when: Logo walls or brand carousels where a flipping transition creates visual rhythm and engagement.
avoid_when: Contexts requiring accessibility — no keyboard control to pause or navigate the carousel.
a11y: Content cycles automatically; no pause control. Focus handling depends on child content.
